jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Prediction Markets)
jobs.jd_full:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Role Description

Prediction markets are one of Phantom's top priorities, and the category is still wide open. The interfaces everyone uses today are not the end state. As a Senior Product Manager on the Predictions team, you'll shape what trading on real-world events should feel like, from five-minute crypto markets to live sports, politics, and culture.

You'll start with something most prediction products spend years building: more than 20 million people who already hold and trade their money in Phantom, tokens, perps, and stablecoins in the same app. We're looking for someone with the creativity to use that, the judgment to decide what matters, and the drive to see it through without waiting to be asked.

Responsibilities

  • Define how Phantom wins in a competitive market. Build on our funded user base, crypto infrastructure, and existing trading products to make discovering, funding, and trading predictions simpler and more connected.

  • Own the prediction markets experience end to end, from discovery to payout.

  • Sweat the design details with our designers. Make trading simpler for someone placing a first prediction and more powerful for someone placing their fiftieth of the day.

  • Build a team that stays close to traders. Talk to them every week, read support tickets, and dogfood every build. Turn what you learn into roadmap decisions, and make these habits part of how the team works.

  • Make every trade trustworthy. Own trade execution, position and PnL accuracy, and clear market resolution, so traders can rely on every number on the screen.

  • Own market discovery and retention. Decide which markets we list and feature, how we surface live events, and how personalization, notifications, and social features give traders reasons to return.

  • Make the calls. Decide what to build, what to cut, and when something is ready to ship, often with incomplete information, and own the outcome.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, and our exchange and liquidity partners to ship in a regulated category. Set shared goals and report progress every week, including what isn't working.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years as a full-time Product Manager or founder, including a consumer product you owned end to end and grew through measurable improvements in adoption, retention, or revenue.

  • You trade yourself (prediction markets, perps, crypto, or something more exotic) and have strong opinions about which products do it well. Comfortable reasoning about order books, liquidity, pricing, and settlement.

  • Original product thinking, with a record of turning what you learned from users into something new that people adopted.

  • Strong design sensibility. You can point to work where you made something simpler without taking power away from the people who wanted it.

  • You stay close to users and use AI agents and data to test what you hear, investigate product performance, and measure whether your decisions worked.

  • You pick up problems without being asked and see them through. You know when to gather more evidence and when to make a call.

  • A close collaborator. You can lead engineering, design, legal, and marketing without formal authority, and you're technical enough to work through exchange, onchain, and data integrations in detail.

  • Bonus points if you have:

    • Worked at a prediction market, sportsbook, exchange, or brokerage.

    • Built something on crypto rails that could not have been built without them.

    • Built real-time, live-event, or high-frequency trading products.

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager in the Chicagoland area to start and lead a new team that owns how we grow and manage the panels behind Recruit. Researchers come to Dscout to find the right participants, and some audiences are hard to reach. This team expands where those participants come from, and makes sure every recruit gets handled in the smartest way possible.

You'll own partner panel expansion, the addition of new recruit panels, and the smart router that decides what to do with a recruit based on its feasibility. You'll also own ongoing maintenance and new features for our existing panel partners. As we add panels, you'll lead the work to combine screener functionality, so researchers get one consistent experience across panels.

You bring the full PM toolkit—user research, roadmap and strategy, and cross-functional delivery. You pair it with real depth in marketplaces, partner integrations, and routing and matching systems, plus a hands-on feel for what LLMs can and can't do. You default to ownership: of the roadmap, of outcomes, and of the quality bar that decides whether a new panel or routing decision is ready to ship.

What you'll do

  • Build and lead the roadmap and strategy for panel expansion, from problem discovery through delivery and iteration
  • Evaluate and select new partner panels, weighing reach, cost, participant quality, and fit for hard-to-fill audiences
  • Lead the combination of screener functionality across partners, so researchers get one consistent experience
  • Define, ship, and evolve the smart router that decides how each recruit gets handled based on feasibility
  • Own the evaluation approach for routing and panel quality: set metrics, measure fill rates and participant quality by source
  • Own maintenance and new features for existing panel integrations
  • Manage partner relationships and dependencies, including redirects and postbacks that sit outside our control
  • Partner with the teams that own recruiting, matching, and Scout profiles, so panel and Scout supply work together
  • Use LLMs directly to prototype ideas, and shape system behavior through prompting and context design
  • Balance both sides of the marketplace, so changes that improve results for researchers stay fair and clear for participants
  • Track the metrics that matter: niche recruit fill rate, time to fill, cost per complete, and participant quality across sources
  • Partner with Design and Research on experiences that are usable and understandable, not just technically correct

What you bring

  • [5–8] years of product management experience, including owning a roadmap end-to-end from strategy through shipped outcomes
  • Experience owning marketplace, supply, or panel products—such as participant recruitment, ad networks, or two-sided platforms—and the tradeoffs between fill rate, cost, and quality
  • Experience working with external partners or vendors, including integrations, contracts, and dependencies you don't fully control
  • Comfort with routing, matching, or decisioning systems, and the logic that determines what happens to a request under different conditions
  • Strong judgment in managing complexity, and in creating consistent experiences across many partners and systems
  • Experience partnering with Engineering on architecture and integration tradeoffs as a peer
  • A high-ownership mindset: you treat outcomes, not deliverables, as your responsibility
  • The influence to align senior stakeholders, make hard calls with incomplete information, and coach other PMs

Nice to have

  • Experience in participant recruitment, panel management, or market research
  • Experience in B2B, ideally in a market adjacent to UX research, market research, or insights
  • Comfort with fast prototypes that get real usage early and then harden into the product, rather than big-spec-first processes

If this role excites you but you're not sure you check every box, we'd still love to hear from you.

Of course, what's outlined above is an ideal set of expectations. Business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager.

About Dscout

Dscout is a team of passionate, empathetic, and curious professionals. As a recognized leader in the Forrester Wave, we’re at the cutting edge of experience research technology. The power of research drives us - how in-context insights from real people can build more enjoyable products and services.

We prioritize learning, sharing, and building. We also deeply value being a diverse and inclusive team and company and look for team members who align with that belief. Join our dynamic team and help shape product roadmaps and business strategies for the world’s most loved brands.

It doesn't stop there. When you join the Dscout team, you will get:

  • A strong and competitive compensation package with a built-in bonus and equity program.
  • An incredible and progressive benefits package (for both you and your dependents) to support work/life balance, including flexible PTO, 15 company holidays, 12 weeks of paid parental leave, 401k match, and much more.
  • An education stipend to support your growth & development, and a remote work stipend.
  • A company that is open and transparent with our team. You will know what is happening and why it matters.

Dscout is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity. We do not discriminate based on identity, including race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged or sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

If you need reasonable accommodations for any part of the employment process, please email us at accommodations@dscout.com with the nature of your request and your contact information. We'll do everything possible to ensure you're well-prepared for success during our interview process, while also upholding your privacy, including accommodating any special requests. Please note that only inquiries regarding requests for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

When you apply at Dscout, we will process your job applicant data, including your employment and education history, transcript, writing samples, and references, as necessary to consider your job application for open positions. For more information about our privacy practices, please visit our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Athennian

Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data. The platform enables organizations managing complex corporate and investment structures to automate governance workflows, maintain audit-ready records and collaborate across functions with confidence.

More than 500,000 entities across over 150 countries are managed on Athennian, helping organizations modernize entity management and transform governance operations into a strategic advantage.

We are a fast-moving, solutions-driven team using an AI-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

About the role

As a Product Manager at Athennian, you help shape how modern governance operations are built for some of the world’s most complex organizations. Working closely with engineering, design, and customers, you identify meaningful problems and turn them into products that bring clarity and efficiency to corporate structures.

This role is suited for someone motivated to build impactful software alongside talented teams. It requires strong product judgment, curiosity, and the ability to move quickly while making thoughtful decisions that advance the platform. You bring a collaborative mindset, learn from those around you, step in to guide when needed, and build strong partnerships across teams to deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers

What you'll do

  • Talk to customers often. Develop a deep understanding of how legal, finance, and governance teams operate and where their workflows break down.
  • Set product direction and roadmap priorities, balancing customer needs, company goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design to turn complex problems into thoughtful, well-built product solutions.
  • Make clear product decisions using customer insight, market context, and commercial inputs such as pricing, packaging, and segmentation.
  • Work with Sales, Support, and Implementation to ensure product launches are well understood and successful for customers.
  • Define product requirements and user stories that help engineering teams build efficiently while maintaining a high bar for quality.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory changes, and how governance operations are evolving.
  • Use AI tools in day-to-day product work to prototype ideas, accelerate discovery, and explore new ways to solve customer problems.
  • Identify opportunities where emerging technologies, including AI, can meaningfully improve customer workflows.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience building B2B SaaS products.
  • A track record of owning product areas from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to make thoughtful trade-offs in fast-moving environments.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and design to deliver high-quality products.
  • Comfortable leading customer discovery and translating insights into product decisions.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and curiosity about how emerging technologies can improve products and workflows.
  • Clear communication and the ability to align teams around product direction and outcomes.
  • Previous experience in a startup/scale up environment
  • Nice to Have: Experience working in Legal-tech, Fintech, or other complex enterprise software environments.

Location

We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada and the US. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in the US and Canada.

Our Culture

Our company thrives in a fast-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in driving success.

Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results.

Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to take ownership from problem identification to implementation.

Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity and reject the status quo.

Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action.

Benefits at Athennian

We’re a remote-first company built on trust, autonomy, and accountability.

Work-Life Balance: Minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days, and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company-wide winter holiday shutdown.

Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, and vision, long-term disability, and a Health Spending Account (HSA).

Family Support: Flexible parental leave benefits, including top-ups.

Remote Setup: A dedicated work-from-home allowance to get you set up for success.

📄 JOB DESCRIPTION

As the Project Manager for Sourcing Excellence, you will play a central role in transforming our Sourcing journey across Europe.

We are looking for someone eager to leverage AI potential for innovation—someone who loves experimenting with AI tools and actively sharing that knowledge across the sourcing team. Reporting directly to the Head of Commercial Strategy, you will take full ownership of shaping, defining, and executing innovative initiatives to improve the sourcing journey — driving solutions across all retail sectors, European Sales Analysts, and Key Account Managers by Q4 2027.

Your core focus will be delivering measurable business value: driving efficiency across the Sourcing journey by streamlining data preparation, designing scalable target processes, and empowering our commercial teams to focus on high-value analysis and negotiation.

🎯 TASKS

  • Develop the strategic vision for the project by synthesizing commercial team feedback and organizational goals, driving innovation through the integration of advanced AI capabilities.
  • Serve as the Project Lead within our delivery framework, taking ownership of business requirements, proof-of-concept validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Invisible

Invisible is an Applied AI research company closing the gap between frontier models and the enterprise. We provide the platform infrastructure that makes AI work in production at scale: unify fragmented data, map complex processes, orchestrate and evaluate agents, and stand up hyper-personalized workflow applications fast for companies like Grubhub, Alliance Global, and Thomson Reuters. Where models fall short, we build RL environments and data to fix them. The result: a virtuous cycle between enterprise deployment and model training.

Recognized as Best Predictive Analytics Platform of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards, Invisible makes AI work.

About The Role

We’re seeking top product talent to embed with strategic enterprise clients in financial services, where modern technology like AI is changing how capital markets work. You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with business stakeholders, translate ambiguous ideas into AI-powered solutions, and shepherd projects from discovery through delivery. A core focus of this role is the developer platforms and tools the client’s engineers rely on every day: you’ll help shape those tools from the ground up and see their impact across the whole organization. Over the next six months, your work will double discovery capacity, develop custom products leveraging AI, unlock new revenue streams for our clients and Invisible, and lay the groundwork for deeper, long-term partnerships.

This is a rare chance to bring a product mindset to developer experience at one of the most influential firms in finance, working on high-visibility projects with a team that wants to move fast.

What You’ll Do

  • Discovery & Scoping: Lead concise, high-impact workshops that surface true business needs, define success metrics, and craft phased, right-sized scopes.
  • Developer Experience: Own the roadmap for internal developer platforms and tooling — understand what slows engineers down, and build products they actually want to adopt.
  • Project Stewardship: Build and own delivery timelines and OKRs, run stand-ups, clear blockers, coordinate directly with engineering teams to advance outcomes, and escalate early to keep work on track.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary product point of contact for strategic enterprise clients, nurturing executive relationships and ensuring alignment.
  • AI-Enabled Solution Design: Combine client context with Invisible’s AI toolkit to architect solutions using classical automation, GenAI, and human-in-the-loop approaches.
  • Continuous Improvement: Document playbooks, mentor new analysts/PMs, and feed insights back into Invisible’s product and sales teams.

What We Need

Required: 

  • 5+ years in product management, solution consulting, or comparable delivery roles.
  • Experience building products for developers — APIs, SDKs, developer platforms, or internal tooling — or a PM background that grew out of developer relations, developer advocacy, or solutions engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products or pilots.
  • Proven success managing enterprise client relationships.
  • High emotional intelligence and excellent communication skills.
  • Extremely high level of personal ownership, entrepreneurial drive, and independence.
  • Adaptable, resilient, curious, ambitious, coachable, low ego critical thinker.
  • Comfortable in a high rate-of-change, evolving, ambiguous environment.
  • Working knowledge of software architecture, APIs, and data flows; curiosity about GenAI.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Notion, Asana).
  • Experience working in highly matrixed, enterprise organizations across multiple stakeholders.
  • Authorization to work in the US and willingness to travel.
  • Ability to work in-person, in-office in NYC 2-3 days per week.

Nice-to-have:

  • Financial services or capital markets experience, especially building developer-facing products in that environment.
  • Deep experience deploying AI/ML solutions in enterprise or regulated environments (e.g., financial services).
  • Experience advising and partnering with senior stakeholders.
  • Prior success scaling hybrid vendor-client teams or launching joint-venture initiatives.

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

The annual salary range for this position is: $164,000 - $212,000

Bonus and equity is included in all full-time, non commission offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

What It’s Like to Work at Invisible:

At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Role: Full Time

Number of positions: 2

Contract Duration: 2 Years, Fixed Term and Contract Renewable

Reports to: Consortium Director

Salary: Annual Gross KES 6,749,952 -KES 8,200,000

Location: Nairobi, Kenya

Deadline for submission: 3 December, 2026

This position is open to Kenyan nationals only

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

 

About Us

Founded in 1992, Nutrition International is a global organization dedicated to delivering proven nutrition interventions to those who need them most. Working in partnership with countries, donors and implementers, our experts conduct cutting-edge nutrition research, support critical policy formulation, and integrate nutrition into broader development programs. In more than 60 countries, primarily in Asia and Africa, Nutrition International nourishes people to nourish life.

For more than 30 years now, Nutrition International has focused on delivering low-cost, high-impact, nutrition interventions to people in need, driven by our mission to achieve a world where everyone, everywhere, is free from malnutrition and able to reach their full potential. Nutrition International’s work is guided by a dedicated and talented team of experts working globally, regionally and within countries to end malnutrition worldwide.

About the NOURISH Investment

The NOURISH investment (Nurture the ecosystem, Optimize the market, Unlock financing, Reinforce ANC platforms, Integrate and Scale MMS and Calcium for Healthy Futures) is an exciting new multi-country investment designed to accelerate the sustainable scale-up of MMS and strengthen systems for the integration of calcium supplementation across Africa. NOURISH takes a comprehensive, systems-based approach that brings together expertise across the critical areas required for successful scale-up: strengthening health systems, improving local product quality, affordability and availability, advancing sustainable health financing, and fostering the enabling policy and implementation environment needed for long-term success.

Funded by Children’s Investment Fund Foundation (CIFF) and led by Nutrition International, the NOURISH consortium brings together a unique combination of global and country-level expertise. Consortium partners currently include UNICEF Ethiopia, Sight and Life Rwanda, and CHAI Ghana, each contributing specialized technical and operational capabilities to support either country-led scale-up or regional efforts. NOURISH is supporting Ethiopia and Rwanda as the first countries to receive support through the initiative. Over the coming years, up to six additional African countries are expected to benefit from NOURISH support, working alongside governments navigate the pathway from MMS introduction to sustainable national scale-up.

Employing a unique partnership approach with a consortium of partners, Nutrition International, together with the donor, is delivering a five-year pan-African initiative – NOURISH – focused on Strengthening Maternal Nutrition Platforms for MMS & Calcium across 8 countries. As the project scales, the volume and complexity of partner-facing delivery, sub-grant management and country-level coordination necessitates project management oversight.

About the Role

The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the delivery of an assigned portfolio within the NOURISH initiative.  This portfolio will be made up of a defined group of countries, technical assistance partners and regional technical assistance partners who each own a scope of work, workplan and budget. The role translates the approved consortium strategy, workplan and budget into executed country and regional workplans, and holds assigned implementing partners to account for scope, timeline, budget, quality and compliance. 

The role carries delegated authority for decisions within the approved workplan and budget, and escalates matters of consortium strategy, donor relations, partner agreements and material budget or scope change to the Consortium Director. The job holder works closely with the Consortium Director, the adjacent Senior Program Manager, a Senior Technical Advisor, a Senior MEAL Advisor and the Finance Manager, who provide technical, monitoring and financial management support across NOURISH.

The Senior Program Manager will be a delivery-focused Manager with a proven ability to run complex, multi-country, multi-partner programs, to hold partners to account constructively in a respectful and inclusive environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Program Delivery and Project Management: Translate the approved NOURISH consortium strategy, annual workplan and budget into coordinated country and regional workplans, collaborating with partners, government stakeholders and Nutrition International country offices. Oversee day-to-day portfolio implementation, monitor activities, milestones and deliverables, lead annual planning and consolidate partner inputs into the consortium-wide plan. Maintain delivery trackers and risk logs, provide regular progress reports to the Consortium Director, resolve operational bottlenecks and escalate issues affecting scope, timelines, budgets or donor commitments.
  • Partner Management and Performance: Serve as the primary management liaison for regional and country implementing partners, leading stakeholder engagement and co-creation workshops. Coordinate the onboarding and orientation of Technical Assistance Partners, ensuring clear scopes of work, budgets, annual workplans, milestone tracking and alignment with NOURISH’s technical, programmatic, MEAL, data systems and governance requirements.
  • Monitoring, Reporting and Learning: Collaborate with the Senior MEAL Advisor to strengthen monitoring, evaluation and data quality across the portfolio, ensuring consistent application of tools and indicators, timely and accurate partner reporting, and data-driven performance reviews to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement.
  • Budget and Sub-Grant Management: Manage the approved portfolio budget, including partner sub-grants; review financial reports and expenditure, investigate variances, prepare cash flow forecasts and budget realignment proposals, and ensure partner compliance with Nutrition International and donor financial procedures and requirements.
  • Technical Coordination and External Engagement: Ensure alignment of portfolio workplans and partner delivery with consortium technical guidance, strengthen engagement with government stakeholders and national coordination platforms, and represent the project at relevant country and regional technical, coordination and partner forums as delegated by the Consortium Director.
  • Consortium Collaboration and Upward Reporting: Provide the Consortium Director with timely, accurate and comprehensive updates on portfolio delivery, risks and expenditure to support evidence-based decision-making and fulfilment of donor commitments. Participate in consortium leadership and management meetings, contributing to strategic discussions and decision-making, while collaborating with Nutrition International teams, including Monitoring, Data and Learning, People and Culture, Corporate Services, Partnerships and Growth, and Communications, to support effective programme delivery.

 Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • The position holds delivery oversight – not line management – of the teams of assigned regional and country-level implementing partners.
  • The position also coordinates the contribution of shared project functions (technical, financing, monitoring and finance) to the assigned portfolio on a matrix basis.

Education/Professional Designations/Experience:

  • A Master’s degree or equivalent experience in public health, nutrition, international development, project management and/or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of experience in health, nutrition or development programming, including at least 5 years managing multi-country or multi-partner programs, with a significant portion of this experience in Africa.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing sub-grants or sub-awards and holding implementing partners to account for delivery, compliance and reporting.
  • Proven experience managing project budgets, including expenditure tracking, forecasting, variance analysis and donor compliance requirements.
  • Experience managing the full project cycle – work planning, implementation, monitoring, reporting and close-out – in complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
  • Demonstrated track record of working directly with government leadership and national coordination structures in the health or nutrition sector.
  • Demonstrated experience line managing and developing staff, including remote and multi-country teams.

Other Specific Skill Requirements:

Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and competence with project management and workplan tracking tools.
  • Strong communication skills (oral and written), including report writing for donor audiences.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent country workstreams and competing deadlines.
  • Fluency in English - both reading and writing – is essential.
  • A working knowledge of French is an asset.

Competencies

  • Delivery Focus: Drives work to completion, anticipates obstacles, and holds self, team and partners to agreed commitments and timelines.
  • Partner Management: Builds productive working relationships with partners while maintaining clear performance standards and accountability.
  • Project Management: Strong planning, coordination and organisational skills across multiple concurrent country and regional workstreams.

Personal Attributes

  • Results-Oriented: Focused on achieving measurable outcomes and maximising impact through efficient program delivery.
  • Collaborative: Works constructively across teams, partners, units and offices to achieve shared objectives.
  • Integrity: High ethical standards with a commitment to transparency, accountability and social impact.

Competitive market pay, comprehensive medical benefits, flexible working hours, generous annual leave, support for professional learning and development, and dedicated health and wellness allowance.

Nutrition International is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and accessible work environment. Applicants with special needs who require adjustments or support are encouraged to reach out during the recruitment process.

We incorporate safeguarding-related questions throughout the recruitment process, including during interviews and reference checks, to ensure a safe and respectful working environment. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Job Title: Sr. Product Manager
Location: 100% Remote - anywhere in the Continental U.S.
Salary: $158,000/year
Note: All advertised positions are salaried and full-time.

About Us

Friends From The City is a design, research, and engineering company focused on public impact. Our mission is to make digital interactions with government simple, intuitive, and accessible. That means removing barriers like confusing user flows, inaccessible content, and language limitations that prevent people from getting what they need.

We build digital products using accessible design, rigorous research, and reliable code.

About the Role

Millions of people rely on government websites and applications to access critical services like healthcare, housing, and financial support. But when those tools are slow, confusing, or difficult to use, it can make essential tasks feel impossible.

As a Product Manager at Friends, you will help lead that work. You will bring clarity, direction, and structure to teams building digital tools that serve real people with real needs. Your role is to ensure we are solving the right problems, delivering usable solutions, and creating lasting impact through thoughtful strategy.

What you’ll achieve:
In this role, you will lead product strategy and delivery for the U.S. Department of State’s Consular Appointment Management Platform (CAMP). CAMP replaces several older scheduling systems with one modern platform that serves more than 300 consular posts around the world. Some of the things you may do include:

  • Shape the product vision and roadmap for CAMP, starting with a global rollout of Non-Immigrant Visa (NIV) scheduling that changes how millions of visa applicants book appointments with the U.S. government
  • Serve as the main liaison to the Bureau of Consular Affairs product team, turning the needs of consular officers, post staff, and the public into a clear, prioritized delivery plan
  • Lead and supervise the full contractor team across product, design, engineering, and training
  • Own the backlog and write and prioritize user stories across the public scheduling experience, the tools post staff use to manage appointments, and a Crisis Volunteer Scheduling tool for State Department staff
  • Work with design and research to make sure every release is based on evidence from users, is fully Section 508 compliant, and works for posts that operate very differently from one another
  • Guide a rollout that starts at a pilot post and expands worldwide, managing post onboarding, change management, and shifting requirements as you go
  • Report progress and risks clearly to Consular Affairs leadership, and tie product decisions to measurable results like appointment completion time and user satisfaction

Skills You’ll Need to Bring:
The ideal candidate will bring a mix of the following:

  • Senior federal product management: you have owned a product roadmap at a federal agency, handled competing stakeholder priorities, and worked through agency governance without losing momentum
  • Agile leadership: you have experience as a product manager, product owner, scrum master, or agile coach, and you can run backlogs, sprint planning, and release planning in a team that deploys every sprint
  • Team leadership: you have supervised a team that spans product, design, and engineering, including staff from partner companies
  • Stakeholder alignment across complex organizations: you have worked with agency IT, program offices, and field users all at once, and you can keep them focused on the same priorities
  • Executive communication: you can run structured briefings with senior government stakeholders and explain technical progress in business terms
  • Risk management and problem solving: you spot delivery risks early and bring solutions

Nice To Haves:
These are not required, but we would love to know if you have:

  • Experience with Department of State, Consular Affairs, or other international or multi-site government operations
  • Experience with scheduling, case management, or high-volume public-facing systems
  • Familiarity with federal compliance work such as the ATO process, Section 508, and the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS)
  • Experience with cloud-based platforms on AWS, or an understanding of API-based architecture
  • Experience running user research, service design sprints, or participatory workshops
  • Knowledge of performance measurement or analytics tools
  • Certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, or SAFe

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline or equivalent experience. 7-9 years of relevant experience preferred.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, valued, and inspired. At Friends From The City, our benefits are designed to help you thrive at work and in life.

Compensation & Time Off

  • Competitive salary based on experience and market benchmarks
  • 401(k) with company match to help you invest in your future
  • 15 days of PTO, 11 paid federal holidays, and paid sick leave
  • Flexible remote work with support for coworking memberships if needed

Health & Wellness

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance and short-term disability coverage
  • Wellness-first culture that respects boundaries and encourages balance

Professional Growth

  • Annual Professional Development Stipend to invest in courses, conferences, books, or coaching
  • Opportunities to lead, mentor, and learn across projects and disciplines
  • Regular feedback, growth planning, and clear career pathways

Work Culture & Values

  • A collaborative, mission-driven team that values your perspective
  • The chance to work on meaningful civic tech projects that directly improve people’s lives
  • An environment where creativity, curiosity, and care are part of the job

Our Hiring Process

  1. Phone Interview
  2. Technical Interview
  3. Final Interview

Visit our Candidate Handbook to learn more about what to expect.
